## Next research batches

Plan status: matches captured client. Editorial research order based on reusable mechanic questions and current coverage gaps, not hero popularity, win rate or certified counter strength.

### 1. Control and channel interactions

Seven, Dynamo, Mo & Krill

First slice reviewed: six conditional channel-interrupt rules; no in-game verification or full-kit coverage.

- Follow up with controlled tests: Knockdown delay vs short channels; protection, removal and Cursed Relic interactions.
- Still open: Static Charge removal, continuous-stun duration reduction, qualifying barrier triggers and personal survival.
- Seven damage markers and Dynamo channel flag are traced to raw properties; alternate tooltip sections and other kit details remain incomplete.

### 2. Healing and persistent damage

Victor, Kelvin, McGinnis

First slice reviewed: healing denial, conditional spirit shielding and separate Inhibitor responses. In-game testing and full-kit coverage remain open.

- Test recipient-specific anti-heal application, Kelvin dome purge/reapplication and buildup timing.
- Resolve turret-trigger attribution, Victor aura toggle interruption and reanimation health separately.
- Extend player delivery coverage beyond the four reviewed heroes without assuming every spirit effect procs identically.

### 3. Flight, movement and escape

Vindicta, Grey Talon, Calico

First slice reviewed: delayed airborne stun/gravity, pre-cast movement denial and Calico melee defense. Targetability, recasts and immunity remain bounded.

- Check movement denial, delivery range and defensive activation windows.
- Distinguish flight, teleport, untargetability and invisibility.
- Review execute wording separately from ordinary bonus damage against low-health targets.

### 4. Remaining roster: typed damage and control

Abrams, Apollo, Baba, Bebop, Billy, Celeste, Deadman Danny, Drifter, Graves, Haze, Holliday, Infernus, Ivy, Lady Geist, Lash, Mina, Mirage, Paige, Paradox, Pocket, Rat King, Rem, Shiv, Silver, Sinclair, Solomon, The Doorman, Venator, Viscous, Vyper, Warden, Wraith, Yamato

Source review pass complete for every captured selectable hero. Partial advice only; no in-game certification.

- Run client tests for the explicit remaining questions in ROSTER_REVIEW.md.
- Extend problem and player-delivery coverage rather than treating one supported scenario as a complete kit.
- Re-review by November 14 UTC; refreshes never renew evidence.

## Reusable function queue

Ordered by number of heroes with no current published advice, then total hero reach. This is an editorial research-efficiency order, not a meta or popularity ranking. Heroes with advice can still have major unresearched threats. Response families are investigation directions, not approved item matches.

### Spirit damage
34 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Confirm damage instances, scaling and barrier timing.
Research directions: Spirit resistance, Damage barrier, Reduce enemy damage output

### Dash / flight / teleport
28 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Research delivery, range and immunity; mobility is not a single interruptible effect.
Research directions: Movement denial

### Healing / regeneration / lifesteal
19 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check recipient, delivery, overlap and whether the effect is healing rather than a shield or deferral.
Research directions: Healing reduction

### Movement slow
19 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Separate movement slow, dash restrictions and ability lockout.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Applied debuff removal

### Delayed / charged damage
17 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check activation window and whether this cast can actually be interrupted.
Research directions: Damage barrier, Interrupt

### Pull / knockback / launch
16 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check displacement directly; immunity or barrier triggers cannot be inferred from movement.
Research directions: Preemptive control immunity

### Damage over time
16 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check removal eligibility, reapplication and ultimate exceptions.
Research directions: Applied debuff removal, Damage barrier, Reduce enemy damage output

### Special control / rules
16 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Resolve the unique effect rather than mapping its name to stun, cleanse or immunity.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Damage protection / avoidance
15 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Determine exact protection and duration; do not treat it as healing.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Stun
14 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Confirm ability rank, duration and proc ordering; do not promise a parry.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Preemptive control immunity, Barrier after qualifying control

### Damage amplification / resist reduction
12 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Separate direct damage from stacking amplification and check removal eligibility.
Research directions: Applied debuff removal

### Channeled ability
11 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Test interruption eligibility, immunity and line-of-sight rules.
Research directions: Interrupt

### Silence
10 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Distinguish silence from stun and item-use restrictions.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Applied debuff removal, Barrier after qualifying control

### Barrier
9 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Investigate barrier-specific responses; healing reduction is not assumed to affect barriers.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Bullet / weapon damage
8 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Separate weapon damage from spirit riders and on-hit effects.
Research directions: Bullet resistance, Bullet immunity, Damage barrier

### Damage type unresolved
7 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Resolve missing damage type from raw fields or current client; Spirit scaling alone is insufficient.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Healing suppression
6 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check whether the debuff can be removed; this is not evidence of enemy healing.
Research directions: Applied debuff removal

### Melee damage
6 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check melee classification, parryability and follow-up timing.
Research directions: Melee resistance, Damage barrier

### Immobilize
6 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Confirm movement restriction and removal exceptions.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Applied debuff removal, Barrier after qualifying control

### Movement / stamina restriction
5 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Determine which movements or abilities are blocked and when removal is allowed.
Research directions: Applied debuff removal

### Execute / threshold kill
4 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Direct current interaction evidence is required; ordinary barriers are not execute protection.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Summons / deployables
4 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check targetability, damage type and which item effects interact with summons.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Stealth / vision denial
3 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Research detection and vision mechanics before proposing item responses.
Research directions: Resolve the specific mechanic before choosing a response family.

### Disarm
2 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check attack and item-use limits separately.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Applied debuff removal

### Sleep
2 heroes mention this theme; 0 have no available published advice in any problem.
Check wake-up and follow-up timing; sleep does not imply interruption.
Research directions: Debuff duration reduction, Barrier after qualifying control

## Promotion gates

- Repair incomplete ability text and alternate-kit gaps before relying on those profiles.
- Read current item facts and independent matchup evidence for each proposed interaction.
- Record exact affected ability, objective, conditions, exclusions, player scope and patch.
- Add behavioral regressions and keep untested interactions labeled source-reviewed.

Never import this inventory into the recommendation engine. New rules require separate source review and regression checks.
